subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: Is the supplied real component-level liveness proof sufficient to land this compatibility-sensitive bootstrap rewrite after current-main SQLite changes altered part of the original stall attribution?
rationale: The patch is correct and independently demonstrates the modified blocking paths, but only the feature owner can decide whether that evidence justifies owning a broad custom glob implementation without a fresh full embedded-run trace.

options.title: Accept component proof
options.body: Approve the clean merge because the still-present synchronous reads, glob walk, and hook chain are independently demonstrated blocking paths with strong parity coverage.

options.title: Require fresh embedded trace
options.body: Pause until a current-main connected or lane-level run attributes material delay to workspace-file-load, hook-overrides, or extra-file traversal.

options.title: Narrow before landing
options.body: Retain async root reads and diagnostics while deferring the custom walker or hook scheduling if their compatibility cost is not accepted.

recommendation.title: Accept component proof
recommendation.body: Approve the clean merge because the still-present synchronous reads, glob walk, and hook chain are independently demonstrated blocking paths with strong parity coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest feature history and made the latest current-main decision on the linked report's changed attribution.
